name: Family Reunification

qualifying_event.description: A separated family member may join a sponsor in Sint Maarten if the sponsor holds Dutch nationality or a valid residence permit.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Proof of family tie; sponsor's proof of Dutch nationality or valid permit.

requirements.blocker_text: The sponsor must hold Dutch nationality or a valid Sint Maarten residence permit.
All requirements for the family relationship must be satisfied before a permit can be issued.

evidence_required.document: Sponsor's proof of Dutch nationality or valid residence permit

outcome.duration_length: temporary, renewable; not specified in the source reviewed

sources.title: Ministry of Justice, Government of Sint Maarten -- Immigration and Border Protection Services: family reunification pathway for separated family members of a Dutch national or valid-permit holder

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Sint Maarten's initial build. No income threshold, marriage-duration figure, or fee schedule was found for this route on the pages reviewed -- unlike the more detailed family-reunification pages found for Aruba and Curacao earlier this session, Sint Maarten's own page gives only the sponsor-status rule ('one holds Dutch nationality or a valid permit') and states generically that 'all requirements must be satisfied' without itemising them. Modelled conservatively; work_rights is 'none' by default absent confirmation otherwise. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months (60 months) reflects the same general 5-year path to permanent residency stated on this page, applicable across Sint Maarten's residence-permit categories.
